name: memory.lol X/Twitter screen-name history API
tier_rationale: Identifiable operator, public README and source code, public track record since 2022 (A8 community); P106 cond 1 'Registry provider memory_lol: tier community'.

reliability.justification: Rebuilt from archived X/Twitter data; anonymous access covers only facts observed in the last 60 days, so an empty answer is not 'no previous handles' (P106 cond 3).

screen_names.title: GET /v1/tw/<screen_name>: numeric account ids that used the screen name and every screen name seen for them, with dates (keyless 60-day window)

terms.quote: In most cases public access to the tool is currently limited to historical facts that have been observed in the past 60 days.

screen_names.notes: Terms 'unknown' (no published service terms; data rebuilt from X/Twitter archives, P106 cond 1/2): disabled in every licence profile until legal records a class (A1). Keyless only: the login/device flow (/v1/login/*) and approval-gated ranges are never used. Missing handles answer 200 {'accounts':[]} (observed); the service does not validate handles, so V3LUM does. The project's code licence (Anti-Capitalist Software License) does not apply: V3LUM reuses no code.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G05-1 (P106 memory_lol). No published rate limit: min_interval 2 s and the module's daily_quota. Handle history is personal data: case-bound, never kept beyond retention_days (P106 cond 5). The optional key 'memorylol' is NOT declared: only if the team obtains an approved account (P106 cond 2, backlog).
